headlines.title: Focus groups: Deep anxiety about the economy drives undecided voters in two key Senate races
headlines.description: Concerns about the economy and high costs are driving the thinking of undecided voters in Iowa and Georgia, according to new focus group conversations, as two states that will be central to the fight for the Senate barrel toward Election Day.

headlines.title: FBI searches former Rep. Eric Swalwell’s home, seizes his electronic devices
headlines.description: The actions, carried out over the weekend, are related to sexual misconduct allegations against Swalwell.

headlines.title: Angie Nixon says 'I'm not a socialist' despite joining DSA
headlines.description: Angie Nixon joins Meet the Press NOW after winning an upset in the Democratic primary to represent Florida in the Senate, saying she's a capitalist despite recently joining the Democratic Socialists of America.

headlines.title: Angie Nixon says Florida 'is not red, it just hasn't been invested in by Democrats': Full interview
headlines.description: Florida's Democratic Senate Nominee Angie Nixon joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss her vision for Florida and stance on the core principles of the Democratic Socialists of America.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Mike Lindell says he’ll pay for recount after loss in Minnesota governor primary
headlines.description: The MyPillow founder is prepared to pay nearly $1 million to cover the costs associated with a hand recount after he lost to state House Speaker Lisa Demuth.

headlines.title: Trump nominates Heidi Overton to lead FDA
headlines.description: Overton, a physician, is a White House aide who often briefs the president on health issues.

headlines.title: New CDC director pledges to ‘speak truth’ about science
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz addressed CDC employees Wednesday in her first agencywide meeting.

headlines.title: Book him: Prosecutors using James Comey’s novel against him in seashells case
headlines.description: Comey’s novel centers on a villain who sends coded messages urging retaliation against his political rivals. In new filings, federal attorneys argue that life imitated art.
